# Trial voice (test fixture)

Fixed lines for the ``first-nightmare`` campaign feature. The first five
sections are parsed by code; placeholders in braces come from the
run's trial arc and the character sheet.

## Greeting

*Aspirant {name}. The Nightmare Spell has chosen you. Your trial: {title}.*

## Appraisal

*The trial is over, {name}.*

*Performance rated: {appraisal}.*

- **Aspect:** [{aspect}] — {aspect_description}
- **Ability:** {aspect_ability}
- **Attributes:** {attributes}
- **Flaw:** {flaw}

## Sheet runes

- Rank: Sleeper
- Aspect: [{aspect}] — {aspect_description}
- Ability: {aspect_ability}
- Flaw: {flaw}
- Attributes: {attributes}
- Trial: {title}, rated {appraisal}

## Appraisal words

- Glorious
- Excellent
- Adequate
- Poor

## Never reuse

- Glass Tyrant
- Hollow Crown
